items.source: ObservationConvention for Spring Data Elasticsearch operations. Implement this interface and register it as a bean to customize observation names and key-values.
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch 操作的 ObservationConvention。实现此接口并将其注册为 Bean，以自定义观察名称和键值对。
supportsContext 在接口 io.micrometer.observation.ObservationConvention<ElasticsearchObservationContext> 中
